purpose: Locator of current FORM authority, not a replacement method or a parallel prescription database.

rules.title: Train to win, not to win workouts
rules.enforcement: coaching doctrine
rules.verification: coach authoring review

rules.title: Distinguish skill, stimulus and recovery cost
rules.enforcement: coaching doctrine
rules.verification: whole-week authoring review

rules.title: Author complete progression and the whole Week story
rules.enforcement: canonical week-story audit and coach review
rules.verification: public.coach_roster_story_audit()

rules.title: Filing, Week and feed are distinct receipts
rules.enforcement: database read and scoped repair
rules.verification: public.coach_filing_integrity_read(integer) and tests/coach-filing-integrity.test.mjs

rules.title: Respect effective sharing and historical permission
rules.enforcement: database permission and source-post repair guards
rules.verification: tests/coach-filing-integrity.test.mjs

rules.title: Show the workout once; preserve only athlete-specific execution cues
rules.enforcement: Coach editor copy audit and typed-work preview review; direct SQL/native paths remain a known gap
rules.verification: private/session-editorial-standard.test.mjs and signed-in athlete Week readback
rules.scope: FORM Week, full running prescriptions, coach-authored edits and plan previews

rules.title: Published dose and RPE must be numerically valid
rules.enforcement: validated PostgreSQL constraints
rules.verification: tests/coach-filing-integrity.test.mjs

rules.title: Glute development and external strength count in the athlete week
rules.enforcement: individual coach prescription and cross-product review
rules.verification: coach authoring review; not an automatic universal dose

rules.title: Preserve observation, athlete report, measurement and inference separately
rules.enforcement: sourced athlete observation and filing records
rules.verification: public.coach_agent_athlete_brief(uuid) source and date fields

rules.title: Agent authorization is action-scoped and every action has a receipt
rules.enforcement: current permission boundaries and agent operating contract
rules.verification: coach/AGENT_OPERATIONS.md

rules.title: Current glute-day placement is approved; change on new evidence, not routine overlap warnings
rules.enforcement: whole-week guardian treats existing strength/run stacking as context
rules.verification: tests/whole-week-guardian.test.mjs

rules.title: File explicitly requested athlete evidence; ask once for incidental meaningful feedback
rules.enforcement: agent feedback capture decision and authorized observation writer
rules.verification: tests/feedback-capture-policy.test.mjs

rules.title: No 3 × 10-minute running intervals or mile repeats; prefer athlete-appropriate sustained work
rules.enforcement: Console and Labs typed session authoring preflight
rules.verification: private/session-editorial-standard.test.mjs; active published-session audit

rules.title: Stimulate → Absorb → Progress: develop capacity to absorb increasingly demanding work
rules.scope: all FORM running and coupled Forge strength programming
rules.enforcement: coach authoring review; automated preflight proposed, not yet verified
rules.verification: whole-week and next-session review; athlete feedback after demanding exposures

rules.title: Callus mind and body through earned, absorbed progression layers
rules.scope: all FORM running and coupled strength programming
rules.enforcement: coach authoring doctrine; no automated gate claimed
rules.verification: review layer purpose, actual execution, recovery, next-session readiness and athlete report

rules.title: Enter marathon-specific long-run work from an absorbable two-hour foundation
rules.scope: marathon-specific long-run block entry; athletes below foundation receive preparatory progression
rules.enforcement: coach-authored readiness and complete-week review; not an automatic first-run prescription
rules.verification: recent actual long-run evidence, athlete report, recovery and next-session capacity

rules.title: Minimum 30 cumulative minutes at MP in any new marathon-pace workout; advanced and elite long-run families
rules.scope: future FORM marathon-specific session authoring, not historical filings or half-marathon goal-pace work
rules.enforcement: coach/Labs session selection review; no automated preflight claimed
rules.verification: explicit MP segments sum to >=30 minutes or equivalent distance at evidence-based MP; elite 3 × 10K protected from default assignment; total weekly burden/fueling/recovery reviewed

rules.title: Own 60–70 continuous MP before advanced broken/alternating work; progress recoveries toward floats
rules.scope: prospective FORM marathon-specific session selection and recovery design
rules.enforcement: coach/Labs progression review; automated checks pending
rules.verification: document stable 60–70 continuous MP with 24–72h recovery before M03/M04; preserve easy reset → shortened reset → coach-defined float; ensure float is slower than MP but not full recovery

rules.title: Study the observed 20–30 s/mi threshold-to-half-capability difference without treating it as universal
rules.scope: sub-1:30 half-marathon coaching cohort observation; individualized assessment only
rules.enforcement: coach evidence review; no automatic pace arithmetic
rules.verification: compare evidenced half capability, stable threshold session splits, perceived cost and next-session recovery; exceptions recorded

rules.title: One development thread from 5K to marathon with individualized continuous, recovery and late-work progression
rules.scope: future multi-distance session authorship and half-marathon canon
rules.enforcement: coach/Labs method review; automated progression checks pending
rules.verification: review event demand, continuous capability, one or two progressive variables, easy-to-float recovery and whole-week cost

rules.title: Prohibit the owner-disallowed term from new FORM program copy
rules.scope: new session title, intent, details, Week preview, coach-authored program and philosophy prose
rules.enforcement: private/session-editorial-standard.mjs covers session fields and Week-preview/presentation utilities; wider writer integration and legacy cleanup pending
rules.verification: private/session-editorial-standard.test.mjs targeted regression; legacy published-session audit dated November 6, 2026

rules.title: Develop standalone easy-running duration beyond short quality-session elapsed time
rules.scope: future running program authoring, particularly half and marathon foundations
rules.enforcement: coach/Labs complete-week review; no automatic minimum or daily hard gate
rules.verification: compare real continuous easy 50–60 then 60–75-minute capacity, easy long run, 24–72-hour recovery; permit shorter recovery days

rules.title: Allow truly continuous pace/easy mile alternation distinct from banned classic mile repeats
rules.scope: half and marathon preparatory pace/easy session authoring
rules.enforcement: separate typed pace and easy segments, no stopped or full-rest classic mile sets; maintain ≥30 cumulative MP minutes for MP-specific work
rules.verification: private/session-editorial-standard.test.mjs; exact filed sequence and aggregate race-pace duration; do not mistake cumulative for continuous

rules.title: Use evidenced half-marathon pace duration to inform, not automatically approve, marathon-specific work
rules.scope: Orlando-to-Donna and analogous half-to-full athlete transitions
rules.enforcement: postrace coach evidence, recovery, fueling and long-run review; no automatic athlete plan edit
rules.verification: check clock-pace comparability, race effort, uninterrupted duration, two-hour easy capacity and closing-marathon durability separately

rules.title: Grade descending 4→3→2 km ladder by work total and transition cost
rules.scope: confirmed descending marathon and scaled half ladder; prospective athlete selection
rules.enforcement: coach selection and full-session anatomy review; no automatic graduation
rules.verification: 4+3+2 km single descent: 9 km work + 2 km easy; double descent: 18 km work + 5 km easy; half scaled descents; MP floor; floats and faster pace earned separately

rules.title: Treat 90–100 minutes continuous MP as a conditional final major marathon rehearsal, not a race prediction
rules.scope: marathon and scaled half specific rehearsal selection
rules.enforcement: coach-authored recovery and taper review; mutually exclusive principal test or dated frozen-study amendment
rules.verification: actual evidenced MP/HMP, continuous segment, fueling, opening/closing cost, 24–72-hour recovery and preserved Closing-10K study

rules.title: Develop first official Donna plan from Orlando evidence while preserving frozen Last 10K authority
rules.scope: José/Hope official marathon plan design before any athlete-specific publish
rules.enforcement: individual coach authoring, date/version reconciliation and explicit principal test decision
rules.verification: Orlando result and recovery, current PT/load restrictions, week-by-week typed sessions, study amendment where required and athlete-visible readback

rules.title: Migrate legacy disallowed vocabulary via contextual versioned coach-authorized revisions
rules.scope: future published legacy planned-session wording, 322 active occurrences at the dated audit
rules.enforcement: current publisher cannot rewrite authored title/intent/details; protected migration workflow not yet available
rules.verification: editorial diff, no-dose-change assertion, full anatomy cloning, per-batch Week readback and zero active-copy audit
